overall: The AG found the School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by not announcing its executive session purpose at the meeting, but declined to find the violation intentional and ordered no further action since the committee had already cured it.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee entered executive session on March 12, 2019 without stating its purpose with sufficient detail.
allegations.key_passage: find that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to announce the reason for the executive session at the time of the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant urged a finding that the March 12, 2019 executive session violation was intentional, citing prior similar violations.
allegations.key_passage: we are persuaded that the failure to announce the purpose at the time of the meeting was an oversight, rather than a deliberate attempt to conceal this information from the public.

remedy: No further remedial action ordered; the committee had already discussed the deficiency at a later open meeting and amended its minutes to explain the executive session reason.
remedy_passage: Therefore, we order no further remedial action.
